decisions.reason: DOI 10.1093/ww/9780199540884.001.0001/ww-9780199540884-e-16908 is the tail of https://www.ukwhoswho.com/view/10.1093/... in the مسار (url) field of the Gee citation template in the ref at cp 1329. The URL has no /doi/ segment, so guide 3.5 gives the identifier text as raw text, as the locked quote does. The DOI runs to the end of the URL (the next character is the | separator), and it is syntactically valid. identifier_link fits a publisher URL in url=. Locked label is right.

DOI 10.2307/4591085 is in the path of https://www.jstor.org/stable/10.2307/4591085?origin=crossref in the مسار field of a citation template. /stable/ is not /doi/, so the raw text is the identifier text. The query ?origin=crossref is not part of the DOI, which the locked key respects. identifier_link fits. Locked label is right.
